name: convergent
description: Adaptive multi-agent implementation and adversarial review workflows powered by GitHub Copilot.

chatParticipants.name: convergent
chatParticipants.description: Inspect or implement a task with an adaptive multi-agent workflow

commands.name: implement
commands.description: Classify, plan, and execute a task using the proportionate Convergent workflow

commands.name: resume
commands.description: Resume the last interrupted workflow from its safest saved checkpoint

convergent.models.coordinator.description: Persistent coordinator model selector. Defaults to strong because this role owns requirements understanding, clarification, task decomposition, acceptance criteria, and workflow classification. Use an exact Copilot model id/name, or one of: strong, planner, cheap-a, cheap-b, auto.

convergent.models.workerA.description: Worker A model selector. adaptive resolves after each task is classified: trivial/low uses the cheap tier, standard uses an economical capable tier, and high-risk work promotes to a stronger implementation tier. An exact model id/name or an explicit preset such as cheap-a/strong overrides adaptation.

convergent.models.workerB.description: Worker B model selector. adaptive-diverse scales capability with task route/risk and avoids Worker A's selected model when a suitable alternative exists. An exact model id/name or explicit preset overrides adaptation; cheap-b keeps its existing low-cost diversified behavior.

convergent.models.reviewer.description: Strong reviewer model selector. The reviewer context is retained for the lifetime of one implementation task.

enumDescriptions: Let the strong coordinator classify read-only, trivial, standard, and high-risk tasks; the engine enforces minimum review levels and escalation.
Force every modifying task through at least the full A/B convergence + strong-review workflow. Read-only tasks remain coordinator-only.
convergent.routingMode.description: How Convergent chooses the workflow depth for each task.

enumDescriptions: Use low/medium/high reasoning effort according to role and route when the selected model advertises support. The coordinator uses medium effort by default.
Do not override model reasoning effort.
convergent.reasoningMode.description: Whether Convergent adapts supported models' reasoning effort to task risk/workflow depth.

convergent.maxWorkerPasses.description: Soft A/B convergence limit per review/fix tranche. When reached without convergence, Convergent asks whether to continue for more passes or pause with the resume checkpoint preserved.

convergent.maxReviewerCycles.description: Soft strong-review/remediation cycle limit per tranche. When unresolved findings remain at the limit, Convergent asks whether to continue for more cycles or pause; it does not fail merely because the counter was reached.

convergent.maxAiCredits.description: Optional soft AI-credit budget for one run. 0 disables the budget. When reported Copilot usage reaches the budget at a safe workflow boundary, Convergent asks whether to add another budget tranche, continue without a budget, or pause and resume later. Credit reporting can lag live token usage.

enumDescriptions: Do not create Git commits automatically.
After an accepted modifying task, create a checkpoint commit only when that task started with a clean worktree. Pre-existing dirty worktrees are never swept into an automatic commit.
convergent.taskCommits.description: Optional task-boundary checkpoint commits. Safe commits make the next task's HEAD the previous accepted task, keeping normal Git diffs task-local while preserving existing dirty user work.

convergent.agentInactivityTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds with no observed agent, usage, or tool activity before Convergent asks whether to keep waiting or abort the current agent turn. This is an inactivity watchdog, not a maximum total turn duration.

convergent.agentTurnTimeoutSeconds.deprecationMessage: Use convergent.agentInactivityTimeoutSeconds. Copilot SDK sendAndWait timeout is a wall-clock limit and is no longer used as the Convergent stall detector.
convergent.agentTurnTimeoutSeconds.description: Deprecated compatibility setting. If explicitly configured while the new inactivity setting is not, its value is used as the inactivity threshold.

convergent.toolStallTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds a running Copilot tool may produce no progress before Convergent shows the tool/command details and asks whether to continue waiting or abort the current agent turn.

convergent.toolStallGraceSeconds.description: Fallback grace period used only when an interactive stall decision UI is unavailable and Convergent must use bounded steering/cancellation.

convergent.heartbeatSeconds.description: Interval for diagnostic heartbeats in the Convergent Output channel. Routine 'working' heartbeats are no longer appended repeatedly to Chat; only meaningful long-tool status is surfaced there.

enumDescriptions: Automatically approve normal workspace reads, writes, and commands; still ask for risky operations.
Ask before shell commands and writes.
convergent.permissionMode.description: How Copilot SDK tool permission requests are handled.

enumDescriptions: Use stdio under a real Node process and the SDK in-process transport inside a VS Code/Electron extension host.
Always use the Copilot SDK in-process FFI transport.

Always use the Copilot SDK stdio child-process transport. With Copilot SDK 1.0.8 this is not suitable inside a VS Code Extension Host because the SDK launches JS CLI files through process.execPath (Code.exe).
convergent.runtimeTransport.description: Copilot SDK runtime transport. Keep this on auto unless troubleshooting.
